shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in package.json app/page.tsx 'app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx' lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx next.config.ts; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done; rg -n "prefetch|Link|project|suspense|loading" app lib'

/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && test -d node_modules && echo NODE_MODULES_PRESENT || true && rg -n '\"next\"|version' package-lock.json | head -12 && rg -n 'cacheComponents|connection\\(|prefetch={false}|prefetch.*Suspense|Partial Prefetching' node_modules/next/dist 2>/dev/null | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'prefetch={false}|prefetch.*loading|connection\\(' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server 2>/dev/null | head -20; rg --files node_modules/next | rg 'cache-components|partial-prerender|connection|link' | head -80; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 5 'prefetch|Suspense|use cache|dynamic|connection\\(' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md | head -260; rg -n -C 5 'prefetch|connection\\(|Suspense' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -160; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md | head -130"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx 'app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx' next.config.ts tsconfig.json && cat tsconfig.json && rg --files .next/server/app/projects | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/project-prefetch-headers -o /tmp/project-prefetch-body -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' 'http://localhost:3210/projects/acme' && cat /tmp/project-prefetch-headers && wc -c /tmp/project-prefetch-body && rg -o 'Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront|Production deployment|Loading project details|Loading project' /tmp/project-prefetch-body | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sSL -D /tmp/project-prefetch-headers -o /tmp/project-prefetch-body -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' 'http://localhost:3210/projects/acme' && cat /tmp/project-prefetch-headers && wc -c /tmp/project-prefetch-body && rg -o 'Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront|Production deployment|Loading project details|Loading project' /tmp/project-prefetch-body | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sSL -o /tmp/project-navigation-body -H 'RSC: 1' 'http://localhost:3210/projects/acme' && rg -o 'Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront|Production deployment|Loading project details' /tmp/project-navigation-body | sort -u && wc -c /tmp/project-navigation-body"

/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > tsconfig.json
rm -r .next next-env.d.ts
git status --short'
